propositions: The wheel probe must deterministically walk and import every rebar.* module and report all import failures without fail-fast semantics, catching subpackage breakage missed by shallow entry-point tests.
Top-level scripts must import cleanly under their documented standalone contract (sys.path isolated from siblings) so one script's sys.path manipulation cannot mask another's missing import.
Optional-dependency modules (mcp, fastapi extras) must be attempted but recorded as skips only when their declared dependency is genuinely absent, not failed for other reasons.
The import walk must be locally runnable and testable in any venv with rebar installed, with no CI-specific dependencies.
Historical import regressions (bare sibling imports without sys.path setup, stale optional-dependency allowlists) must be caught by the walk's deterministic reporting mechanism.
